description: This file implements an Azure-specific extension of a real-time large language model (LLM) service for OpenAI, tailored for usage with Azure OpenAI endpoints with Azure authentication. It defines the class `AzureRealtimeBetaLLMService`, which inherits from `OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService`, and includes methods for initializing the service and establishing websocket connections.

classes.name: AzureRealtimeBetaLLMService
classes.description: A subclass of `OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService` specialized for Azure, incorporating Azure-specific authentication and endpoint handling. It includes a deprecation notice indicating it will be replaced in future versions.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Azure-specific real-time LLM service with API key and base URL, issuing a deprecation warning about the class itself.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to establish a websocket connection to the Azure endpoint, attaching the API key in headers, with error handling and reconnection logic.
